notes: Magpi (formerly DataDyne) was a mobile data-collection service; it discontinued operations in February 2025 and every Magpi host is now down or parked, so this spec is a historical record and the adaptor cannot currently work. No machine spec ever existed. The spec covers the whole documented surface recoverable today: legacy XML Outbound API (Get Surveys, Get Survey Data v1 and v2), the v3 URL the adaptor hard-codes, the JSON REST Outbound API on api.magpi.com (list forms, list questions, answers with start/limit/searchQuery, sub-form answers), and the Inbound API (GetSurveyForm, UploadRecordsNew), plus the adaptor-only /mobileApi/uploadData that submitRecord builds but never sends (marked deprecated). The support docs were readable only through search-engine excerpts (support host gone, Wayback blocked here), so response field lists are NOT known: Form, Question and Answer are open objects, legacy Get Surveys is an opaque XML string, and SurveyData evidences only LastSubmissionDate (from the adaptor). Legacy XML data responses are modelled as the JSON array of records the adaptor produces after XML conversion. The earlier stub's invented fields (UploadResponse, start/limit on legacy calls, a real-looking token example) were removed. If a Wayback copy of the three support articles becomes reachable, fill in the field lists and the Inbound status-code table.
